answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the dawn funding graph is rebuilt from the walnut history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 355 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 355 bonds yet holds one position, and the ridge report publishes the merged exposure. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
